trains.says: Yes, unless you turn it off
trains.quote: When you use our services for individuals (Free, Plus, Pro), we may use your content to train our models.

switch.says: Settings, then Data controls, then turn off "Improve the model for everyone"
switch.quote: To opt out, turn off Improve the model for everyone under Settings > Data controls in ChatGPT, or select Do not train on my content in our Privacy Portal.

kept.says: Even a temporary chat may be kept for up to 30 days.
kept.quote: OpenAI may keep a copy of a temporary chat for up to 30 days for safety purposes.

private.says: Temporary chat: not used for training
private.quote: A temporary chat stays out of your chat history and is not used to improve OpenAI models while it remains temporary.

catch.says: A thumbs up or down can send the whole conversation to training.
catch.quote: If you choose to provide feedback, the entire conversation associated with that feedback may be used to train our models.

trains.says: Yes, unless you turn it off
trains.quote: We may use your Inputs and Outputs to train and improve Anthropic AI models, unless you opt out through your account settings.

switch.says: Privacy settings, then turn off the model improvement setting
switch.quote: If you decide to turn off the model improvement setting, we will not use your previous or new chats or coding sessions for future model training.

kept.says: If you allow training, your data can be kept for up to 5 years.
kept.quote: If you allow us to use your chats or coding sessions to improve Claude, we may retain your data in a de-identified format for up to 5 years in our model training pipelines.

private.says: Incognito chat: not used for training
private.quote: Your Incognito chats are not used to improve Claude, even if you have enabled Model Improvement in your Privacy Settings.

catch.says: Chats flagged for breaking the rules are kept for up to 2 years.
catch.quote: We retain inputs and outputs for up to 2 years and trust and safety classification scores for up to 7 years if your chat or session is flagged by our automated trust and safety systems as violating our Usage Policy.

trains.quote: If that setting is on, don’t enter data that’s confidential or that you wouldn’t want a reviewer to see or Google to use to improve its services.

switch.says: Gemini Apps Activity, then turn off "Keep Activity"
switch.quote: To stop your future chats from being reviewed to improve Google services, turn off your Keep Activity setting.

kept.says: 18 months by default. You can change it to 3 months, 36 months or forever.
kept.quote: You can change your auto-delete setting in Gemini Apps Activity from the default of 18 months to 3 months, 36 months, or indefinite.

private.says: Temporary chat: not used for training
private.quote: Temporary chats are not used to train Google’s AI models.

catch.says: People may read your chats, and the ones they read aren't deleted when you delete your activity.
catch.quote: Chats reviewed by human reviewers (and related data like your language, device type, location info, or feedback) are not deleted when you delete your activity.

trains.quote: You can opt out of use of your conversation activity for model training at any time.

switch.says: A model training control in Copilot's settings
switch.quote: You can also control whether Copilot uses your conversation activity for model training or to personalize your experience.

kept.quote: By default, we store conversation activity for 18 months.

catch.says: Personalisation is a separate setting, and it is on by default.
catch.quote: If personalization is available to you, it will be on by default.

trains.says: Yes, unless you turn it off
trains.quote: We may use your content and interactions with Grok (e.g., prompts, searches, and other materials you submit) along with Grok's responses to train our models.

switch.says: Settings, then Data Controls, then "Improve the model"
switch.quote: Mobile App Data Controls for Training Grok: On the mobile app, to select or deselect using your content for model training, go to Settings, Data Controls, and select or deselect “Improve the model.”

kept.says: Private Chat is deleted within 30 days. No fixed period given for regular chats.
kept.quote: When using Private Chat, your conversation history will not be viewable to you and will be deleted from SpaceXSI systems within 30 days.

private.says: Private Chat: not used for training
private.quote: When using Private Chat, where available, your content and interactions are not used for model training.

catch.says: Turning it off only covers new conversations.
catch.quote: Once you select that your data should not be used for training, your new conversations will not be used to train our models.

trains.quote: Input and output data are used by default to train our artificial intelligence models, unless you opt out of training at any time.

switch.says: You can opt out at any time. This page doesn't give the menu path.
switch.quote: You have the right to opt out of this program at any time.

catch.says: A thumbs up or down lets them use that chat, whatever your setting.
catch.quote: In any case, and whichever subscription plan you adhere to, providing feedback by using the "thumbs up" or "thumbs down" button and adding a comment authorize us to use your rating, your input and output in order to improve the behavior of our artificial intelligence models.

trains.says: Yes. The policy describes no off switch.
trains.quote: To improve and develop the Services and to train and improve our technology, such as our machine learning models and algorithms.

kept.says: For as long as you have an account
kept.quote: For example, when we process your Personal Data to provide you with the Services, we keep this Personal Data for as long as you have an account.

catch.says: Your data is stored in China.
catch.quote: To provide you with our services, we directly collect, process and store your Personal Data in People's Republic of China.

trains.says: It may. The policy page describes no off switch.
trains.quote: Improve or create services and products, including our AI models.

catch.says: Email content is excluded from training.
catch.quote: We do not use the content of emails to create, train, improve, or fine-tune AI models.
